divergence_justification: The 197,931 only_oracle rows are an intrinsic row-level representation gap. Canonical mimic-iv/concepts/treatment/code_status.sql:36-65,67-77 unions ICU chart rows with hospital poe/poe_detail rows selected by poe.order_type='General Care' and poe.order_subtype='Code status'. The served MIMIC-on-FHIR warehouse has no resource or FHIR path preserving those hospital code-status POE events, poe.ordertime, or poe_detail.field_value. The nearest MedicationRequest.identifier.where(system='http://mimic.mit.edu/fhir/mimic/identifier/medication-request-poe').value stream is unrelated: its identifiers had zero intersection with selected code-status POE IDs, and authoredOn/status do not carry the missing payload. An independent full-data source count found exactly 197,931 selected POE/detail rows, matching the entire residual; the candidate's 71,141 chart rows have zero only_candidate rows, so the representable branch is exact. Every defensible mapping was tried: exact Observation system/code 223758, valueString, effective variants with TIMESTAMP_NTZ, identifier.value casts, ICU Encounter/partOf/hospital spine, and Observation.id timestamp-witness recovery. No divergent dependencies exist.

reopen_history.reason: Type B cast defect: TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(REGEXP_REPLACE(col, offset-strip), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss[.SSSSSS]") returns NULL on any shape the pinned format misses (date-only values especially), and TRY_ makes it silent -- those NULLs reach the judge as differing_null_only/gap_shaped, i.e. a parse failure disguised as a FHIR coverage gap at the lower bar. Replace every datetime mapping with a bare TRY_CAST(col AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ). See pathling-sql SKILL.md and MIMIC_NOTES.md:337.
